about: Situations of the assistant on the bases of ask_eval_cases.json (by name): what the person writes, the cases it should cite, the facts it should hold, the documentation, the tool, the action it should propose, the question it should ask. Read by the ignored test assistant_eval in assistant.rs. `forbid` on a base applies to every reply on it. `{model}` in `must` stands for the label of the model that answered.
